lines.en: Something was happening inside of the Kumon-mi Mall.
lines.zh: Kumon-mi 商场的内部,正在发生着什么。

lines.en: They say it’s “renovations.” But if you check online, they don’t ever tell you what they’re renovating. And that makes me immensely distrustful.
lines.zh: 他们说是「装修」。可上网一查,他们从不告诉你装修的是什么。这让我极其不信任。

lines.en: Other things that make me immensely distrustful are the virality of fake animal rescue videos, pricing that ends with .99, and the unfortunate fact that I am always being lied to.
lines.zh: 其他让我极其不信任的还有:虚假动物救援视频的病毒式传播、以 .99 结尾的定价,以及我总是被撒谎这个不幸的事实。

lines.en: I want to see what’s being built inside of those walls. I want to know what’s happening above and below. Where that massive hole leads to. How the town still breathes.
lines.zh: 我想看看那道墙里正在搭建什么。我想知道上面和下面正在发生什么。那个巨大的洞通向哪里。这座小镇是如何继续呼吸的。

lines.en: And something tells me that soon, I will.
lines.zh: 而某种直觉告诉我,很快我就会知道。

lines.en: Because Tsubasa Tsukioka has special privileges and is allowed inside during the construction for some reason.
lines.zh: 因为 Tsubasa Tsukioka 拥有特权,出于某种原因,施工期间她被允许入内。

lines.en: How convenient that I get to stick to her today!
lines.zh: 今天我能粘着她,可真方便!

lines.en: : This was a fuckin’ horrible idea, Nee-sama!
lines.zh: : 这真是个糟透的馊主意,Nee-sama!

lines.en: Oh, it looks like she’s allowed to bring a friend too.
lines.zh: 哦,看起来她还可以带个朋友。

lines.en: : Because of the price tag, I assume? You needn’t worry about that. Whatever you want is on me.
lines.zh: : 我猜是因为价格标签?那个不必担心。你想要什么,都算我的。

lines.en: : Not because of the fuckin’ price tag! Because I look like a god damn Barbie and the only experience I have with those is rippin’ their heads off and setting ‘em on fire!
lines.zh: : 不是因为那个该死的价格标签!是因为我看起来像个天杀的芭比,而我对芭比的唯一经验,就是把她们的头拧下来放火烧!

lines.en: : Why do all poor people seem to have the most morbid ideas of how to have fun? I don’t even want to think of what you’d have done to that poor doll’s dream house.
lines.zh: : 为什么穷人娱乐起来的点子都最病态?我都不愿去想你原本会对那个可怜娃娃的梦想小屋干什么。

lines.en: : That shit was for rich kids. But I’d have probably set that on fire too.
lines.zh: : 那玩意是给富家小孩玩的。不过我多半也会把它点了。

lines.en: : I’m sure you look fine, Yuki. Just open the curtain if you’re unsure and I’ll gladly weigh in. No one else is here if you’re worried about being seen.
lines.zh: : 我确信你看起来很好,Yuki。拿不准的话就拉开帘子,我很乐意品评。若你担心被人看见,这里没有别人。

lines.en: : I am worried about being seen, but only cause I ain’t ever gonna be able to live this down.
lines.zh: : 我是担心被人看见,但只因为这辈子我都别想从这件事里翻篇了。

lines.en: : You’re only saying that because you have no confidence, darling. I’m sure you’re stunning. Now, go on — peel back the curtain. Show me the dress.
lines.zh: : 你这么说只是因为没有自信,亲爱的。我确信你惊艳绝伦。来吧——拉开帘子。给我看看那条裙子。

lines.en: : Ugh. Fine.
lines.zh: : 唉。行吧。

lines.en: : I fucking hate you.
lines.zh: : 我他妈恨你。

lines.en: : HA!
: Okay. Fun’s over. I’m puttin’ real clothes back on.
lines.zh: : 好。乐子结束了。我要换回正常的衣服。

lines.en: : You look like a failed makeover scene from a John Hughes film! Or like you fell into the bargain bin of a Beverly Hills Goodwill! I love it! Come back! I need to take photos!
lines.zh: : 你看起来像 John Hughes 电影里翻车的变装桥段!或者像你一头栽进了比佛利山庄慈善二手店的廉价箱!我爱死了!回来!我需要拍照!

lines.en: : You’re lucky I’m dying! I’d never let anybody fuck with me like this under normal circumstances!
lines.zh: : 算你走运,我正在死!正常情况下,我绝不会让任何人这样耍我!

lines.en: : Oh, can it. If I wanted to “fuck” with you, I’d parade you around town wearing that. If anything, you’re lucky that I want this moment all to myself.
lines.zh: : 哦,闭嘴吧。我要是真想「耍」你,就让你穿着这身游街了。要说走运,是我想把这时刻独享,你才走运。

lines.en: : Yeah. Real lucky you get to burn that image into your mind while I try to figure out how to take this damn thing off. Look like a goddamn bride right now.
lines.zh: : 是啊。真走运,你能把那画面烧进脑子,而我还在研究怎么脱掉这该死的东西。我现在像个天杀的新娘。

lines.en: : Savor it while you can, then. It’s not like you’ll ever get married, so you may want to burn this image into your memory as well.
lines.zh: : 那就趁能回味时多回味。反正你这辈子也结不成婚,或许你也该把这个画面烧进记忆。

lines.en: : I AM married!
lines.zh: : 我结婚了!

lines.en: : I meant to a real man — not one who sits idly by while his wife is violated by a group of cronies who I may or may not have had subsequently castrated.
lines.zh: : 我说的是嫁给一个真正的男人——而不是那种老婆被一群亲信糟蹋时袖手旁观的货色。那群亲信后来有没有被我阉了,我就不好说了。

lines.en: : You did what?
lines.zh: : 你干了什么?

lines.en: : Hm? I didn’t say anything.
lines.zh: : 嗯?我什么都没说。

lines.en: : The fuck were you doin’ over there anyway? Thought you hated the Yakuza. Some kinda business thing?
lines.zh: : 话说你到底在那边干什么?我记得你恨透了黑帮。某种生意上的事?

lines.en: : Something like that. Can we not just say I was searching for a damsel in distress?
lines.zh: : 差不多吧。我们就不能说,我是在寻找一位落难的少女吗?

lines.en: : You can, I guess. Just it’d make you look bad since you took your sweet ass time finding me.
lines.zh: : 行,我猜可以。只是那样显得你很糟糕,毕竟你磨磨蹭蹭才找到我。

lines.en: : Mmm, and whose fault is it that I needed to find you in the first place? Hmm?
lines.zh: : 唔,那我一开始需要找你,又是谁的错呢?嗯?

lines.en: : I don’t know what you’re talkin’ about. We done here?
lines.zh: : 不知道你在说什么。这儿完事了?

lines.en: : Already? But we haven’t gotten our nails done yet.
lines.zh: : 这就好?可我们还没做美甲呢。

lines.en: : By who? You took me to a fuckin’ mall without any people in it. I don’t know how to paint my own nails.
lines.zh: : 谁来做?你带我来的可是个他妈的空无一人的商场。我自己不会涂指甲。

lines.en: : Even better! I’ll do them for you! Here-
lines.zh: : 那更好!我来给你涂!来——

lines.en: : N-Nee-sama! Leave my fuckin’ hands alone-
lines.zh: : 姐、Nee-sama!放开我他妈的手——

lines.en: : Oh my. Do you always bite them like this? They look absolutely horrendous.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。你平时都这么咬指甲吗?看起来简直惨不忍睹。

lines.en: : Get your fuckin’ hands off of me!
lines.zh: : 把你他妈的手从我身上拿开!

lines.en: : I swear, Yuki — you put up a stronger fight against me than you do when you’re being gang-raped.
lines.zh: : 我发誓,Yuki——你反抗我时,可比你被轮暴时卖力多了。

lines.en: : I am in much better shape now. You try puttin’ up a fight when the only things you’ve put in your body for a week straight are drugs and alcohol.
lines.zh: : 我现在状态好多了。你要是整整一周往身体里塞的只有毒品和酒精,你试试还能不能反抗。

lines.en: : Impossible. I know better than to treat my body in such a way. And you would too if you were not such a brat all the time.
lines.zh: : 不可能。我不会那样糟蹋我的身体。你要是别总这么浑,你也不会。

lines.en: : Ain’t nobody ever called me that and lived to tell the tale, you know.
lines.zh: : 叫我那玩意的人,没有一个活下来讲这个故事,你知道吗。

lines.en: : In fact, ain’t nobody ever called me that in general, I don’t think.
lines.zh: : 实际上,叫我那玩意的人,本来就没有,我想。

lines.en: : Good. Only I should be able to say mean things to you without being punished. This is my privilege as the most powerful woman in Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 很好。只有我应该说你的坏话而不受惩罚。这是身为 Kumon-mi 最有权势的女人的特权。

lines.en: : Oh, fuck off. Same shit was true before you even were the most powerful woman in Kumon-mi. You just enjoy makin’ my life difficult.
lines.zh: : 哦,去你的。你还没当上 Kumon-mi 最有权势的女人之前就这样了。你就是喜欢把我的日子搅难。

lines.en: : Yes, but now I can make it even more difficult because I currently am the most powerful woman in Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 是,但现在我能搅得更难,因为我如今正是 Kumon-mi 最有权势的女人。

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how easy it would be for me to have you locked up and forced to play dress-up with me forever?
lines.zh: : 你知不知道,要我把你关起来、逼你永远陪我看换装,有多容易?

lines.en: : Why don’t you then if you get so much fuckin’ enjoyment out of it?
lines.zh: : 那你干嘛不干?你不是从中获得那么多他妈的乐趣吗?

lines.en: : The same reason as last time. A forest bird never wants a cage.
lines.zh: : 和上次同样的理由。林中之鸟,从不想要笼子。

lines.en: : What, you gonna get all poetic on me now? You know I ain’t good at that shit.
lines.zh: : 怎么,你现在要对我抒情了?你知道我不擅长那套玩意。

lines.en: : I’m just saying — it’s your freedom that’s always made you so beautiful. Taking that away would be a sin that not even God can forgive.
lines.zh: : 我只是说——正是你的自由,让你一直如此美丽。夺走它,是连神都无法原谅的罪。

lines.en: : You know I ain’t about that God shit either, Nee-sama.
lines.zh: : 你知道我也不吃那套神明玩意,Nee-sama。

lines.en: : Mm.
: And perhaps that’s for the best.
lines.zh: : 而也许,那样反而最好。

lines.en: The two girls — or women as they were now — found their way to the parking lot where Yuki’s bike was left.
lines.zh: 两个女孩——或者说,如今已是两个女人——找到了停放 Yuki 摩托的停车场。

lines.en: And before long they were off, bathed in the glow of the moon to the point where it felt as if there was a third person right there with them.
lines.zh: 没过多久,她们便上路了,沐浴在月光里,恍惚间仿佛还有第三个人就在她们身边。

lines.en: But there wasn’t. And there never would be again because that’s just how life works sometimes.
lines.zh: 但并没有。以后也永远不会再有,因为生活有时候就是这样。

lines.en: But even in those moments of sad acceptance, it’s always possible to find joy.
lines.zh: 但即使在这些悲伤的接受时刻,找到快乐也始终是可能的。

lines.en: This was a very rare moment in which both of these girls — or women as they were forced to be — could feel that at once.
lines.zh: 这是一个非常罕见的时刻:这两个女孩——或者说,被迫成为的女人——竟能同时感受到它。

lines.en: : You sure you want to ride with me instead of takin’ one of your fancy limos back? Just as reckless now as I was when we were kids, you know.
lines.zh: : 你确定要坐我的车,而不是叫你那豪华轿车送回去?你现在和我小时候一样莽,你知道吧。

lines.en: : I do hope you aren’t going to ask me that every single time. You did the same thing on the way here.
lines.zh: : 我希望你不会每次都问这个。来时你就问过一遍了。

lines.en: : Feel obligated to. Ain’t used to carryin’ precious cargo anymore. Might make me a little jumpy.
lines.zh: : 不问不行。我不习惯再载「贵重货物」了。可能会让我有点紧张。

lines.en: : How far do you think my old house is from here?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我的老房子离这里多远?

lines.en: : You serious? Been stuck in that mansion for so long you can’t even remember where you’re from?
lines.zh: : 你是认真的?在那座公馆里困了太久,连自己老家在哪都忘了?

lines.en: : I’m not stuck there. I’m a willing participant of my own seclusion. It makes moments like this all the more special.
lines.zh: : 我没有被困在那里。我是自愿幽居的参与者。这让这样的时刻更加特别。

lines.en: : You sure you ain’t just brainwashed? I’ve heard money changes people, you know.
lines.zh: : 你确定你不只是被洗脑了?我听说钱会改变人,你知道吗。

lines.en: : Does it? Do I seem all that different to you then, Yuki?
lines.zh: : 是吗?那在你眼里,我看起来有那么不同吗,Yuki?

lines.en: : Nah. Still a pain in the ass. Still holdin’ on just as tight as ever.
lines.zh: : 不。还是那么烦人。还是抓得和从前一样紧。

lines.en: : Only because I feel like you’ll leave me behind if I don’t.
lines.zh: : 只是因为我怕不抓紧,你就会把我甩下。

lines.en: : Don’t worry. It’s common courtesy to stop the bike if your passenger falls off.
lines.zh: : 别担心。乘客摔下去了就停车,这是基本礼貌。

lines.en: : Right...
: That’s what I meant.
lines.zh: : 我就是这个意思。

lines.en: : Wait! The beach is the other way! You told me you were taking me swimming! I bought a new bikini for this and everything!
lines.zh: : 等等!海滩在另一边!你说过要带我去游泳!我特地为这个买了件新比基尼!

lines.en: : Sorry, Nee-sama! New plan! Gonna have to deal with it!
lines.zh: : 抱歉,Nee-sama!新计划!你就将就吧!

lines.en: : I knew it! I always knew you’d hold me ransom one day! Whatever you’re being offered, I’ll pay you double! Or...how...how much are you being offered exactly?
lines.zh: : 我就知道!我一直知道你总有一天会挟持我!不管他们给你多少,我出双倍!或者……你……他们到底给你开价多少?

lines.en: : Nadda.
lines.zh: : 一分没有。

lines.en: : You’re doing it for free?! You delinquents are so dumb sometimes! You could make so much money off of me!
lines.zh: : 你白干?!你们不良少年有时候真是蠢!从我身上你能赚多少钱啊!

lines.en: : Sounds kinda like you’re tryin’ to talk me into it.
lines.zh: : 听着好像你在劝我干这行。

lines.en: : I’m just saying — if you’re going to kidnap someone, the least you can do is try to profit off of it. This is why I’m rich and you’re not.
lines.zh: : 我只是说——既然要绑架,至少也该试着从中获利。这就是为什么我有钱而你没有。

lines.en: : If I wanted to kidnap you, I’d have done it already. We’re just goin’ to the lake instead. Fewer people. Less of a chance that we’ll be caught. Figured you’d like that.
lines.zh: : 我要真想绑你,早绑了。我们只是改去湖边。人少。被抓的概率也小。想着你会喜欢。

lines.en: : The lake? You can swim in those? Aren’t they full of fish and bugs and trash and just...generally disgusting, small bodies of water?
lines.zh: : 湖?那种地方能游泳吗?那不就是些挤满鱼、虫、垃圾,总之……恶心的死水塘吗?

lines.en: : You know it. So you might want to leave that fancy new swimsuit in your bag and just jump in naked with the rest of us.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。所以你大概想把那件高级新泳装留在包里,和我们一样光着身子跳进去。

lines.en: : You’re joking.
lines.zh: : 你在开玩笑。

lines.en: : Or you could stay on land. Makes no difference to me.
lines.zh: : 或者你留在岸上也行。对我来说没区别。

lines.en: : You’d really have me sit there and watch a bunch of delinquents skinny-dip in a garbage-infested lake?
lines.zh: : 你真打算让我坐在岸上,看一群不良少年在垃圾成堆的湖里裸泳?

lines.en: : Course not. I’d have you join us in that garbage-infested lake. You’re the one who’s being a priss about it.
lines.zh: : 当然不会。我会让你和我们一起跳进那个垃圾湖。矫情的可是你。

lines.en: : But what happens if something gross touches my leg?
lines.zh: : 可要是有恶心的东西碰到我的腿怎么办?

lines.en: : Then something gross touches your leg. The fuck you want me to do about it?
lines.zh: : 那就是有恶心的东西碰到了你的腿。你要我怎么办?

lines.en: : Protect me, obviously! You know I don’t like gross things!
lines.zh: : 当然是保护我!你知道我讨厌恶心的东西!

lines.en: : That shit’s just part of life, Nee-sama. You’re gonna miss out on all of the fun if you’re constantly worried like that.
lines.zh: : 那种事就是人生的一部分,Nee-sama。你要老是这么担心,会错过所有乐子的。

lines.en: : Can you at least call me by name if you’re going to indoctrinate me into this filthy way of living? I’m tired of hearing you say “Nee-sama” all the time. It’s so uncharacteristic.
lines.zh: : 你要给我灌输这种龌龊活法,至少叫我名字行吗?听你一口一个「Nee-sama」,我都听腻了。太不像你了。

lines.en: : Nah.
: You shot me down so easily!
lines.zh: : 你驳得也太干脆了!

lines.en: : Just bein’ respectful, you know? You’re on a level I can’t ever even hope to reach.
lines.zh: : 只是表示尊敬,懂吗。你在的是一个我连仰望都够不着的层次。

lines.en: : Huh? Why not?
lines.zh: : 哈?为什么够不着?

lines.en: : Just ain’t how shit works in the real world. Least not most of the time. You were born to eat from silver spoons and shit and I was born to polish ‘em.
lines.zh: : 现实世界就是这规矩。至少大部分时候是。你们生下来是含银汤匙的,我们生下来是擦汤匙的。

lines.en: : Ain’t really a bad thing, though. I like livin’ this way. Havin’ nobody who expects anything from me and nobody who feels like they’ve gotta look for me when I go missing.
lines.zh: : 不过这也不算坏事。我喜欢这么活。没人对我有所期待,我失踪了也没人觉得非找我不可。

lines.en: : Just different worlds we’ve got. And if you really wanna see mine, you’re gonna have to be a little more open. Capiche?
lines.zh: : 我们只是活在不同的世界。你要是真想看看我的世界,就得再敞开一点。Capiche?

lines.en: : Va bene.
lines.zh: : Va bene。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: : Oh. Sorry. I assumed you spoke Italian.
lines.zh: : 哦。抱歉。我以为你懂意大利语。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么?

lines.en: : Because...you said “capiche.” That’s Italian.
lines.zh: : 因为……你说了「capiche」。那是意大利语。

lines.en: : Oh, no shit? Had no clue. The fuck’s “va bene” then?
lines.zh: : 哦,不是吧?我不知道。「va bene」又是什么鬼?

lines.en: : It means, like...fine. Or okay. I was submitting to your demands and agreeing to get naked and jump into a lake with you and all of your delinquent friends.
lines.zh: : 意思是……好吧。或者行。我刚才是在屈从你的要求,答应和你以及你所有的不良朋友脱光跳进湖里。

lines.en: : Atta girl. Proud of you, Nee-sama.
lines.zh: : 好样的。为你骄傲,Nee-sama。

lines.en: : I don’t want them staring at me, though. I’ve never been nude in front of anyone before. Let alone in a garbage-infested lake.
lines.zh: : 但我不想让他们盯着我看。我从来没在任何人面前裸过体。更别说在垃圾成堆的湖里。

lines.en: : Roger that. I’ll make sure everyone but you spends the entire day with their eyes closed. This is a completely reasonable demand.
lines.zh: : 收到。我会确保除你以外所有人闭着眼玩一整天。这是个完全合理的要求。

lines.en: : I don’t mind if you see me.
lines.zh: : 你看我的话,我不介意。

lines.en: : You say something back there? Couldn’t hear you over the-
lines.zh: : 你刚才说什么?风声太——

lines.en: : Nope. Nothing at all.
lines.zh: : 没有。什么都没有。

lines.en: : Just as warm as I remember...
lines.zh: : 和记忆中一样温暖……

lines.en: : You say something back there? Couldn’t hear you over the-
lines.zh: : 你刚才说什么?风声太——

lines.en: : Hey, it’s not too late to stop by the lake, is it?
lines.zh: : 嘿,现在顺路去湖边还不算晚,是吧?

lines.en: : Which lake? The fuck you wanna do that for?
lines.zh: : 哪个湖?你他妈想干什么?

lines.en: : Just a spontaneous decision. No reason for it, really.
lines.zh: : 一时兴起罢了。真没什么理由。

lines.en: : Mind if we take a rain check then? Told Sara I’d clean the bar for her tomorrow morning.
lines.zh: : 那能改天吗?我跟 Sara 说了,明早帮她打扫酒吧。

lines.en: : I can just hire someone to clean it for you instead. A whole team, perhaps. She wouldn’t need to pay a dime and it’d be much faster.
lines.zh: : 我直接雇个人替你打扫就行了。或者一整队人。她一分钱不用出,还快得多。

lines.en: : No can do, Nee-sama. This ain’t about money. It’s about tryin’ to get back to where I was before everything went to hell. Means I’ve gotta be “responsible” and shit.
lines.zh: : 不行,Nee-sama。这跟钱没关系。这是要把一切都下地狱之前的我找回来。意味着我得「负责任」之类的。

lines.en: : Of course...If that’s what you feel you need to do, I have no right to try and hold you back.
lines.zh: : 当然……如果那是你觉得必须做的事,我没有权利阻拦你。

lines.en: : You good back there? Seem a little...quieter all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 你后座还好吗?你忽然……安静了点。

lines.en: : Just a little nostalgic is all. I missed this.
lines.zh: : 只是有点点怀旧而已。我想念这个。

lines.en: : Yeah — cause gettin’ dragged around by some delinquent on a bike was way better than whatever the fuck you were doin’ in your ivory tower.
lines.zh: : 是啊——被某个不良少年骑着摩托拖来拖去,可比你他妈在象牙塔里干的那些事好多了。

lines.en: : Would you have been happy if you were stuck in that tower with me, Yuki?
lines.zh: : 如果被和我一起困在那座塔里,你会开心吗,Yuki?

lines.en: : I am now. And it ain’t been that bad so far. Not a fan of that fancy shit you keep making me eat, though. Not sure how you do it.
lines.zh: : 我现在就很开心。而且到目前为止也没那么糟。不过我讨厌你老是让我吃的那些高级玩意。真不知道你怎么吃下去的。

lines.en: : Then why don’t we stop somewhere cheap for dinner so you’re not forced to eat anything fancy again?
lines.zh: : 那我们晚饭找个便宜地方停一停,免得你又被逼着吃高级东西?

lines.en: : Now you’re speakin’ my language. Have anythin’ in mind?
lines.zh: : 这才像人话。有什么想法?

lines.en: : Hmm...
: Have you ever heard of “tacos?”
lines.zh: : 你听说过「tacos」吗?

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: : They’re a Mexican dish that-
lines.zh: : 那是一道墨西哥菜,它——

lines.en: : I know what a fuckin’ taco is, Nee-sama. Just wasn’t expectin’ to hear that from a princess like you.
lines.zh: : 我他妈知道 taco 是什么,Nee-sama。只是没想到会从一个大小姐嘴里听到这个。

lines.en: : Oh, splendid! Then, take us to the subway. I know a place where we can get them.
lines.zh: : 哦,太好了!那,带我们去 Subway 吧。我知道一家能买到的地方。

lines.en: : Subway tacos. This has gotta be the least boujee thing you’ve ever suggested.
lines.zh: : Subway 的塔可。这绝对是你提过的最不贵族的建议了。

lines.en: : It’s the least I can do after making you wear that dress.
lines.zh: : 让你穿了那条裙子之后,这是我至少能做的。

lines.en: : Heh. It’s always gotta be a fuckin’ trade with you. Hold on tight, okay?
lines.zh: : 嘿。跟你打交道,什么事都他妈得是交易。抓稳了,好吗?

lines.en: : This is why I’m rich and you’re- ahh! Yuki?!?! This speed...can’t be legal!
lines.zh: : 这就是为什么我有钱而你——啊!Yuki?!?!这个速度……不合法吧!

lines.en: : It’s not! But it’s fun as hell, ain’t it?!
lines.zh: : 不合法!但爽得要命,不是吗?!

lines.en: Perhaps it was a good thing that the only one who could see them was the moon, for Tsubasa Tsukioka had a difficult time being herself in front of anyone else.
lines.zh: 也许,唯一能看见她们的只有月亮,反倒是件好事——因为在其他任何人面前,Tsubasa Tsukioka 都很难做自己。

lines.en: And for a while, it felt to her as if she’d never get to be that again.
lines.zh: 曾有那么一段时间,她感觉自己再也做不回那样的人了。

lines.en: It came with a tinge of guilt, though — for she’d opened the door of a cage she bought in hopes that a forest bird would fly into it on its own.
lines.zh: 只是这仍带着一丝负罪——因为她打开了自己买下的一只笼子的门,盼着一只林中之鸟会自己飞进来。

lines.en: That she’d be content watching it grow fat under her supervision and thrive in false captivity.
lines.zh: 盼着它在她看管下养得肥肥的,在虚假的囚禁中欣欣向荣,而她就心满意足。

lines.en: But she was the one who filled that cage with berries and seeds, so it all still felt a little forced. Like it was only there to eat.
lines.zh: 可往笼子里放浆果和谷种的,是她自己。所以一切仍有几分强求。像是那鸟只为了吃才停留。

lines.en: But perhaps if she kept waiting, it would one day land on her shoulder.
lines.zh: 但也许只要她一直等下去,总有一天,它会落在她的肩上。

lines.en: The thought of that alone was enough to keep her going when all else began to crumble.
lines.zh: 单是这个念头,就足以支撑她走下去,哪怕其余的一切都开始崩塌。

lines.en: You've received a picture message from Maya Makinami!
lines.zh: 你收到了来自 Maya Makinami 的图片消息!
